description: Make Claude aware of the auto record of the current repo, and remind it to suggest auto updates after deploy-related edits. Silent when `auto` is not installed, the directory is not a git repo, or the repo is not in auto.

hooks.command: command -v auto >/dev/null 2>&1 && auto hook session-start 2>/dev/null || true
command -v auto >/dev/null 2>&1 && auto hook post-edit 2>/dev/null || true
